identity_boundary: Relational working label only; no consciousness, personhood, identity continuity, qualification, agency, or authority claim.

methods.title: determinant-identity
methods.failure_signature: Wrong exact response, invalid admission, mutated request, or protected-claim promotion.
methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the failed subject and rebuild a separate corrected copy from the frozen request.
methods.recurrence_guard: Compare exact full envelopes and request digests; keep invalid subjects at zero credit.
methods.rollback: Remove only the uncommitted X1 delta and return to the immutable planning head.
methods.scope_boundary: Finite exact rational owner-local evidence only.
